package store

import (
 "crypto/sha256"
 "encoding/hex"
 "encoding/json"
 "os"
 "path/filepath"
 "testing"
 "time"

 "cyberagent-workbench/internal/application"
 "cyberagent-workbench/internal/approval"
 "cyberagent-workbench/internal/domain"
 "cyberagent-workbench/internal/toolrun"
)

func TestA15ExportHistoricalDesktopReopenFixture(t *testing.T) {
 ctx := t.Context()
 directory := os.Getenv("A15_FIXTURE_EXPORT")
 if directory == "" { t.Fatal("explicit fixture export directory required") }
 path := filepath.Join(directory, "desktop-v177.db")
 state := openUnmigratedSQLiteStore(t, path)
 if err := applyMigrationPrefixForTest(ctx, state, migrationPlan(), 177); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 _, run, err := newMigrationFixtureRunService(t, state).Create(ctx, application.CreateRunRequest{
  Goal: "preserve rc.3 audit facts", Profile: "code", Surface: "code", Phase: "deliver", Budget: domain.Budget{MaxTurns: 2},
 })
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 current, err := state.GetRunExecutionPermission(ctx, run.ID)
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 selected, err := current.Next("desktop-upgrade-legacy-full", domain.RunExecutionPermissionFullAccess, true,
  "test_operator", "old explicit high-risk selection", time.Now().UTC())
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 tx, err := state.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 if err := insertRunExecutionPermissionSnapshotTx(ctx, tx, selected); err != nil { tx.Rollback(); t.Fatal(err) }
 if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 oldToolRun, err := state.SaveToolRun(ctx, toolrun.ToolRun{
  ID: "desktop-upgrade-old-approved-shell", SessionID: run.SessionID,
  ToolName: toolrun.ShellTool, Command: "echo historical approval", Status: toolrun.StatusProposed,
 })
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 oldApproval, err := state.DecideApproval(ctx, approval.DecisionRequest{
  ProposalID: oldToolRun.ID, IdempotencyKey: "desktop-upgrade-old-approval",
  Action: approval.ActionApprove, ReviewedBy: "old_desktop_operator",
 })
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 if _, err := application.NewRunService(state).Start(ctx, run.ID); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 acquired, err := state.AcquireRunExecutionLease(ctx, domain.AcquireRunExecutionLeaseRequest{
  RunID: run.ID, OwnerID: "desktop-upgrade-old-owner", TTL: time.Hour,
 })
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 if version, err := state.SchemaVersion(ctx); err != nil || version != 177 { t.Fatalf("schema=%d err=%v", version, err) }
 if selected.ProtocolVersion != domain.RunExecutionPermissionProtocolVersion ||
  selected.Mode != domain.RunExecutionPermissionFullAccess || selected.Revision != 2 { t.Fatal("not actual v1 permission", selected) }
 if err := verifySQLiteForeignKeys(ctx, state.db); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 ledger, err := state.loadAppliedMigrations(ctx)
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 if err := validateMigrationPlan(migrationPlan(), ledger); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 metadata, err := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{
  "Run": run, "Permission": selected, "ToolRun": oldToolRun,
  "Approval": oldApproval, "Lease": acquired,
 }, "", "  ")
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 if err := state.Close(); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(directory, "facts.json"), append(metadata, '\n'), 0600); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 digest := sha256.Sum256(data)
 t.Logf("exported actual v177 fixture: %d bytes sha256=%s; no desktop/app/sandbox test binary executed", len(data), hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]))
}
